## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: strong sector breadth plus cyclicals leadership (Industrials and Energy showing multiple ABOVE TREND names); Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: Value/Cyclical favored over Growth.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Industrials lead: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +17.72%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +11.40%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing leadership pockets: JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples lagging: WMT (1W: -7.97% | 1M: +3.04%) CORRECTION, MDLZ (1W: -4.95% | 1M: +2.53%) CORRECTION. Materials weak: NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND, DOW (1W: -6.52% | 1M: +7.43%) CORRECTION. Technology has mixed internals with big names BELOW TREND: INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5) — cyclical/value weight.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -18.06%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -4.37% | 1M: -27.50%) BELOW TREND, NUE (1W: -4.66% | 1M: -0.12%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in higher-multiple Tech and select Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +14.04% | 1M: -8.91%) RECOVERY, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND, DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND, GE (1W: +9.69% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged (several large-caps with 1W up but 1M down such as SHOP, PYPL, AMZN) — watch for trend breaks; treat as tactical opportunities, not blanket exposure increases.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed internals with meaningful dispersion: AAPL (1W: +1.09% | 1M: +6.94%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.54% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, GOOGL (1W: +1.94% | 1M: -4.08%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -10.35%) BELOW TREND. Sector is participating in the rally but tech breadth and large-cap divergences warrant stock selection.

8. Financials Outlook?
Patchy but constructive: JPM (1W: +2.69% | 1M: +2.90%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +6.58% | 1M: -25.48%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -1.00% | 1M: -1.13%) BELOW TREND. Financials overall show pockets of strength that support the RISK-ON tone; rotate into stronger names.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Cautious/neutral internals: JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -16.61%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare has selective strength but mixed short-term signals — prefer names with confirmed above-trend action.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals and select energy/industrial names (DE, OXY, AMAT, GE) while reducing exposure to lagging high-multiple Tech names showing sustained BELOW TREND behavior (INTC, ORCL, PANW). Style: Value/Cyclical over Growth; stay selective given large-cap divergences and short-term recoveries.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/guidance follow-through, AMAT (1W: +14.45% | 1M: +15.56%) ABOVE TREND — momentum, OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND — commodity tailwinds. BEARISH: PANW (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -18.06%) BELOW TREND — downside momentum, INTC (1W: -5.10% | 1M: -18.69%) BELOW TREND — continued weakness, ORCL (1W: -5.37% | 1M: -14.84%) BELOW TREND — earnings/cycle risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Industrials (DE, GE) and Energy (OXY, CVX) — breadth supportive. BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples — recent soft 1W performance and negative internals.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (watch close above recent monthly highs for continuation; failure to hold weekly support would shift tech tone). AAPL (monitor hold of the 1M uptrend; loss would widen tech divergence). JPM (sustain above this week's breakout zone to confirm financials rotation). DE (follow-through above this week's gap would validate industrial leadership).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+85): JNJ (1W: -0.84% | 1M: +11.23%) CORRECTION — FDA breakthrough news but short-term sell-off; divergence to monitor. DE (+75): DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND — earnings/guidance bulls and price confirming. LLY (+60): LLY (1W: -2.61% | 1M: -6.24%) BELOW TREND — clinical news positive but price not confirming, watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-50): BA (1W: -3.06% | 1M: -7.21%) BELOW TREND — negative report and price confirming downside. EL (-45): EL (1W: +7.34% | 1M: -3.09%) RECOVERY — downgrade headlines versus short-term bounce = divergence. PANW (-45): PANW (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -18.06%) BELOW TREND — security/sector headlines and price confirming weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON with a Value/Cyclical tilt given Industrials and Energy leadership. DE (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +25.11%) ABOVE TREND and OXY (1W: +13.96% | 1M: +19.15%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is large-cap divergence (several big names in RECOVERY or CORRECTION) and notable news-driven divergences (JNJ, LLY) that warrant monitoring.
